INTRD DATRS
SEPT 23,2026

Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the B3-2 Community Shopping
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 6-H in the area bound by:

West Cermak Road: a line 120.0 feet east of and parallel to South Oakley Avenue; the
public alley next south of and parallel to West Cermak Road; a line 96.0 feet east of
and parallel to South Oakley Avenue.

to those of B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 2249 West Cermak Road, Chicago, Illinois.
